T055 is implemented and passes its checks; nothing is committed yet. Typecheck passes and all 552 unit tests (74 files) pass. Lint and the format check also pass.

**What changed:**
- **League distribution:** each division pays an equal share every league round, recorded as one `league-share` entry per season. One table, `DISTRIBUTION_CONFIG` in `finance.ts`, holds the share for every country and division, amateur league included.
- **Merit:** a merit payment (`league-merit`) at the season close replaces the old rank prize. The bottom club gets nothing; the champion's total is 1.6× the bottom club's in the top flight and 1.3× below.
- **Parachute:** a relegated club keeps half the share it lost, for one season only (`parachute`).
- **Football index:** a new `footballQuote` scales the shares, the merit, ticket receipts, the remaining cup and continental match bonuses, and the cup and continental prizes.
- **Removed:** league games no longer pay a result bonus (the sponsor's league bonus stays), and fan income is gone entirely.
- **Gate:** attendance now comes from local supporters, which is the smaller of the club's following and its catchment. The catchment depends on division, a per-country town factor and stature (`CATCHMENT_CONFIG` in `fans.ts`). Price, form, the opponent, marketing and the strategy cards then set the turnout. Attendance can't exceed the local supporters or the stadium's capacity. The old reputation and facility-comfort factors are dropped.
- **Ledger and screens:** the breakdown names the three new lines (리그 분배금, 리그 순위 배분금, 강등 보전금). The cash projection lists 리그 분배금, 강등 보전금 (only while it is paying), 후원 성과 보너스 and 리그 순위 배분금. The finance screen also shows local supporters against the catchment.
- **Tests:** added for the share totals, merit order, the one-season parachute, a third-tier club with 2M followers drawing no more than its catchment, and no `fan-income` entries.

**Things to know:**
- **Starting constants:** all the constants are first estimates for T062 to calibrate. In a 1950 test run, a new amateur club's income is about the same as before; a fourth-tier club gains about £2.5k a season; and a top-flight club with 228k followers draws 17–24k.
- **Income mix can't shift by itself:** because both the distribution and ticket income grow with the same index, the index can't move the income mix from matchday-heavy in the 1950s to distribution-heavy in the 2000s. T062 will need to tune the share table or attendance for that.
- **No city data:** clubs have no city in the game data, so the "city" part of the catchment is a per-country factor. The owner's club counts as ordinary stature.
- **Cup and continental bonuses:** match result bonuses for cup and continental games remain, because the task says "end for league games". You may want to end those too, since ECON-27 lists only cup and continental prizes.

T056 구현을 마쳤습니다. 후원 수입이 이제 다섯 자리별 계약에서 나옵니다. 검사 명령 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit`은 75개 파일, 559개 테스트 모두 통과했고 lint와 format:check도 통과했습니다. 다만 golden 계약 테스트(`pnpm run test:contract`)는 실패합니다(아래 참고). 커밋과 제출은 하지 않았습니다.

**구현 내용 (새 파일 `packages/engine/src/sponsors.ts`)**
- **자리 열림:** 국가별 카탈로그 연도에 맞춰 열립니다. 경기장 명명권은 시설 10단계 이상이어야 열립니다.
- **제안 금액:** 디비전, 평판, 지난 시즌 순위, 팬 수(많을수록 증가 폭이 줄어듦), 축구 지수로 구단의 상업 가치를 매기고, 자리별 비율(10/25/45/15/10%)을 곱합니다. 운영 전략과 시너지 효과도 반영됩니다.
- **계약 종류와 기간:** 안정형 3시즌, 성과형 2시즌, 독점형 4시즌, 물가 연동형 5시즌입니다. 금액은 계약 기간 내내 고정되고, 재계약할 때 다시 매깁니다.
- **지급:** 계약마다 리그 경기당 분할 지급되고, 계약 전 경기는 소급하지 않습니다. 장부에는 자리별로 시즌당 한 항목(`sponsor:<slot>`)으로 쌓입니다.
- **보너스:** 메인 스폰서는 리그 승리·무승부 때, 용품 후원은 승격이나 우승 때 지급합니다.
- **강등:** 진행 중인 모든 계약의 남은 기간이 30% 줄어듭니다. 남은 기간의 70%를 반올림해 남기므로, 1시즌 남은 계약은 줄지 않습니다.
- **위임과 알림:** 운영을 맡기면 비어 있는 모든 열린 자리를 그날 안정형으로 채우고 한 번 보고합니다. 맡기지 않으면 시즌 시작에 빈 자리 알림을, 4월 1일에 마지막 시즌 계약마다 `sponsor-ending` 알림을 보냅니다.
- **후원 탭:** 자리마다 계약 카드나 제안 카드를 보여 주고, 닫힌 자리는 열리는 시즌(추정이면 표시)이나 필요한 시설 단계를 알려 줍니다. 금액은 모두 `<Money>`로 표시합니다.
- **장부와 기타:** financialBreakdown이 다섯 자리의 이름을 표시하고, 현금 전망은 모든 계약을 반영합니다.

- **테스트:** `sponsors.test.ts`에 7개 테스트를 넣었습니다. 요구된 네 경우 외에 위임·용품 보너스, 4월 1일 알림, 장부 이름·독점 계약도 확인합니다.

- **golden 테스트 실패:** `founding-and-commercial-decisions`는 저장된 명령에 이전 `sponsor`가 남아 있어 오류로 실패합니다. `french-redenomination`과 `modern-european-season`은 후원 계약이 없는데도 현금이 맞지 않습니다. golden 재생성은 T062 몫이고, 생성 스크립트(`scripts/update-golden.ts`)는 이미 `sign-sponsor`로 바꿔 두었습니다.
- **e2e:** 허용 목록에 없어 실행하지 못했습니다. `tests/e2e/business.spec.ts`와 `save-upgrade.spec.ts`는 새 방식에 맞게 고쳤지만 검증되지 않았습니다.

- **SSOT에 올릴지 정할 판단:** 보너스가 없는 자리에는 성과형 제안을 내지 않았습니다. 용품 보너스는 시즌 경계에 지급되어 새 시즌 장부에 잡히고, 불확실하므로 현금 전망에서 뺐습니다.

  - 엔진: `projection.ts`, `operations.ts`, `news.ts`
  - 웹: `host.ts`, `protocol.ts`, `App.tsx`, `outcome.ts`, `EventCenter.tsx`(후원 만료 알림에서 구단 운영 화면을 열도록 한 줄 수정)
  - 테스트: 엔진 테스트 다섯 개, `persistence.test.ts`, e2e 스펙 두 개
  - 스크립트: `benchmark.ts`, `update-golden.ts`

**Engine**
- **Vacancies:** every departure (resignation, retirement at 70, an unrenewed contract, a firefighter whose season ends) goes through `resign`.   - 능력 최고: no school preference;
  - 운영 전략 우선: the school the aimed synergy needs (`aimedSynergy` in synergy.ts).
- **Contract and report:** 2 seasons (1 for a firefighter, never past his 70th year), the fee paid, a hire event and an inbox report.
- **Nobody affordable:** the interim stays without stopping the clock, an attention report goes out, and the staff retry daily until someone is affordable.
- **1 April renewal:** if the rule's pick is at least 3 OVR better, the staff let the manager go and report it; he leaves at the close and they appoint then. Otherwise he is renewed for 2 seasons.
- **`manager-rule`:** now works; choosing the default stores nothing.

- The staff tabs are now 감독 · 코치진 · 위임.

Wages are fixed for the term and priced on the football index (staffQuote). Release pays 25% of the wage per season left, counting the current one (releaseCost/managerPayoff). Managers no longer renew themselves: a 1 April reminder goes out for any expiring manager, and an unrenewed one leaves at the close. Delegated coach hires and renewals now really run 2 seasons (before, a renewal at the season boundary added 3). ClubStaff has the term dial and the cost line.

T061: resign() appoints through appointDelegatedManager under delegation.manager. It sets no w.critical, so the clock runs on. When nobody is affordable the interim stays and the staff retry daily. delegatedManagerPick looks only at free agents and uses the STAFF-15 affordability test with the current manager's wage freed. The school, best and strategy rules work as specified. The 3-OVR renewal margin applies on 1 April. manager-rule is implemented, with the default stored as absent. STAFF_TABS drops 감독 후보. 교체/감독 선임 opens the market dialog, and ?view=candidates, the departure alert and the remedies open it too. The 위임 tab has the 감독 선임 toggle and the rule dial.

The tests cover each acceptance bullet: terms, the 70 cap, release per season left, no self-renewal, each rule, the unaffordable best being skipped, a delegated renewal kept against a free agent 2 better, and the e2e journeys.

I did not run typecheck, unit tests or e2e myself. This review was read-only and the review checkout has no node_modules, so I relied on code reading plus the workers' records: 557 unit tests and staff.spec in Chromium.

findings.message: On 1 April the delegated staff decide to let the manager go because the rule's free agent is 3+ OVR better. Nothing re-checks that decision at the close. The market refreshes at rounds 40 and 44, and each refresh drops each free agent with 25% chance, so the rival is often gone by the close. resign() then appoints whoever is best and affordable at that point, who can be weaker than the manager who was let go. This follows the literal STAFF-14/18 wording, but it can leave the delegated owner with a worse manager. Hand off to planning (update-ssot STAFF-18): either re-check at the close and renew if no 3+ better free agent remains, or keep the 1 April rival. Then add a test where the rival leaves before the close.

findings.message: Several STAFF-18 rules are the worker's interpretation, and the task result already lists them. The aimed synergy for 운영 전략 우선 is a heuristic: the school synergy with the most conditions met (at least 2), because every BUILD_PRESET aims at a synergy with no manager school. When nobody is affordable, the interim stays without a stop and the staff retry daily. A daily retry falls back to the best overall under 같은 학파 우선. An owner hire under delegation does not take the post back. Planning should confirm or replace each of these through update-ssot STAFF-18. Do not change them in code without that decision.

The 'candidates' remedy still says '성향이 다른 감독 네 명의 장단점과 선임 비용을 비교해요' (four managers). That describes the removed four-candidate tab. It now opens a market of 4–8 free agents plus other clubs' managers. Reword it to describe the market, for example 자유계약·다른 구단 감독과 선임 비용을 비교해요. The management.spec.ts comment the worker mentioned needs the same fix.

Two small display issues. (1) TermCosts shows the total as wage × term + fee. Wages are paid per round (finance.ts roundShare), so a mid-season hire's first 'season' costs only the remaining rounds, and the total overstates what the owner will pay. Label it as an upper bound or count the rounds left. (2) When the term limit is 1 because of age (a non-firefighter aged 68 at renewal or 69 at hire), the term dial is hidden and no reason is shown; only firefighters get one. Show the disabled dial with SEVENTY, or a note, so the sheet says why only one season is offered (WEB-40).

Both workers left the ARCH-28 entry budget (250 KiB gzipped JS+CSS) unmeasured. Rich.tsx is imported eagerly by App.tsx, and ClubStaff now adds TermDial, TermCosts, ManagerRenewal, ManagerHireTerm, ManagerRuleDial and the market dialog. The last recorded measurement left only about 6 KB of headroom (249,558 bytes at WEB r49). At integration, read the entry gzip size from the `pnpm run build` output or run benchmark:browser. Also, after the locator fix staff.spec was re-run only in Chromium; the full e2e run in integration should cover Firefox and WebKit.
